VBO:0200673.summary: Hounds encompass diverse hunting breeds, including scent hounds that follow trails and sighthounds built for pursuit. Beagles and Whippets illustrate different branches of this group, whose hunting methods and character vary widely.
VBO:0200673.shortDescription: Hounds include scent-trailing and sight-pursuit breeds, from Beagles to Whippets.
